comments.body:
Hello!
 
 This is a curious issue. Doesn't trigger when building spirv, so seems related to DXIL only.
 Depending on the array size, It fails at different places, but always in the ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp file, around the SROA
 Tries to run the transform on the texture2D array, so before it's removed because unused, but somehow yes, commenting-out the first float3x3 solves the issue.
 Leaving that to DXIL maintainers
